name_zh: 范龙佩/比利时/欧盟主席/赫尔曼/常设主席/里斯本/机构建设
description_zh: 赫尔曼·范龙佩 (1947-) 欧盟首任常设主席 (2009-2014)，里斯本条约后建立常设主席制，以安静外交推进欧盟机构建设，欧元区危机协调财政契约/银行联盟，共识政治风格化解成员国分歧，比利时首相经验助力欧盟机构化。
description_en: Herman Van Rompuy (1947-) EU first Permanent President (2009-2014), established permanent chair post-Lisbon Treaty, advanced EU institution building through quiet diplomacy, Eurozone crisis coordinated fiscal compact/banking union, consensus politics style resolved member state divergences, Belgian PM experience aided EU institutionalization.
reason_zh: 范龙佩代表技术官僚如何通过共识政治推进超国家机构建设，展示了常设主席制如何为欧盟提供连续性领导力，其安静外交风格为多元成员国协调提供了新范式，比利时共识政治经验欧盟化。
reason_en: Van Rompuy represents how technocrat advances supranational institution building through consensus politics, demonstrating how permanent chair provides EU continuous leadership, his quiet diplomacy providing new paradigm for diverse member state coordination, Belgian consensus politics EU-ized.
